title: Imperium in Imperio: A Study of the Negro Race Problem. A Novel
summary: "Imperium in Imperio: A Study of the Negro Race Problem. A Novel" by Sutton E. Griggs is a historical fiction novel published in 1899. Their paths converge in Waco, Texas, where a secret shadow government of Black men operates with revolutionary aims.
